body:
## What it does

Works like a small studio rather than a single-format image tool. Hand it the idea once and it can return key art, a style guide, correctly sized graphics for social, something print-ready, a written brief for the product, a landing page or a slide deck, all sharing one look. It runs when you ask it to, rather than on a timer.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @arni0x9053 shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
